scope: hash-pinned analysis-only clarification; no collection, seed, model, or fitting-boundary change
reason: v2 declared SD_train_base but did not define its atomic observation.
dispersion_rule: For each seed and candidate, use the population SD over the 32 base-train histories of the same history-level quantity averaged by that metric: endpoint residual is per-history mean squared frozen-tracker residual across channel coordinates; lag deficit is per-history mean squared frozen-model residual across its eight transitions; route AUC is per-history time-mean route norm. Zero or nonfinite SD excludes that seed from the standardized median.
tie_break: For every eligible metric, calculate per-seed c[m,s]/SD_train_base[m,s], take its median over valid seeds, and select the unique largest absolute standardized effect magnitude. Exact equality means no nomination.
claim_boundary: Selection remains descriptive and does not establish a channel or route mechanism.
